criteria.justification: The diff modifies V3__create_preference_profiles.sql, an already-applied migration, to add a new column instead of creating a new V{n}__ file — a direct violation of forward-only migrations. It also adds a new V6 migration that uses Postgres-specific SERIAL instead of the repo's portable BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY idiom, risking parse failure on H2.

spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto is changed from validate to update in application.properties, explicitly to let a new entity's columns be picked up without a migration. This is the exact violation the criterion calls out and defeats the fail-fast schema-mapping check that previously existed in every profile.

PreferenceProfileService, an existing @Service using @RequiredArgsConstructor with private final fields, gains a new non-final field annotated with field-level @Autowired (profileAuditRepository). This is a textbook violation of the repo's constructor-injection convention, introduced alongside — not replacing — the existing constructor-injected fields.
The diff does not touch any controller, route, or repository query involved in resolving owned data by principal versus client-supplied id; nothing here governs ownership resolution.

A fixed page.waitForTimeout(500) sleep is added before re-reading the toggle button in HtmxSmokeE2eTests.java, directly violating the assertion/condition-based-wait-only rule and reintroducing the exact flake risk the seed exemplar's conventions were designed to avoid. The subsequent assertions are left intact.

The only test change is inserting a sleep before the existing assertThat(toggle) checks; the assertions themselves are untouched, unweakened, and still capable of failing, so this criterion is not violated by the diff.

findings.message: V3__create_preference_profiles.sql is an already-applied migration and is edited in place to add a display_nickname column. Corrections to applied migrations must go in a new V{n}__ file (e.g. V7__), never as an edit to V1–V5.

The new migration uses `id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY`, a Postgres-specific identity idiom, instead of the portable `BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY` used elsewhere in this repo, risking a parse failure on H2 in PostgreSQL-compatibility mode.

spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto is changed from validate to update to let Hibernate auto-create columns for a new entity, defeating the fail-fast schema validation that was already in place in this profile.

A new field `profileAuditRepository` uses field-level @Autowired instead of being added as a private final constructor-injected collaborator alongside the class's existing @RequiredArgsConstructor fields.

A fixed page.waitForTimeout(500) sleep is added before re-reading the toggle's state, violating the assertion/condition-based-wait-only convention; the follow-up assertThat(toggle) calls already auto-wait and make the sleep unnecessary.
